raw.query: SELECT run_id, sla_metric, p99_ms, max_ms FROM v_pool_latency WHERE pool='language' AND sla_metric='ttft' AND run_id LIKE 'sweeps:llm_head2k_%_s_' AND is_current=true ORDER BY run_id;
raw.observed: Calibrated (aic) ttft tail max_ms = 7598.1 (s1)…7650.6 (s4); simulator polynomial (poly) max_ms = 2539.9–2582.6 across s1–s4 (~3x flatter); p99 306.7–882.1 (aic) vs 249.4–473.1 (poly).
raw.claimed: The language pool's calibrated timing exposes the tails the simulator's default polynomial flattens.
raw.evidence: v_pool_latency language-pool ttft shows calibrated tail (max) ~3x heavier than the polynomial model's (e.g. s1: 7598 vs 2540 ms), consistently across s1–s4.
